description: Read of a generated PNG (96x64, three stripes), so image token counts can be tested.
exercises: image block in a tool result
steps: claude -p --output-format json --permission-mode bypassPermissions --strict-mcp-config --session-id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003 "Read diagram.png with the Read tool and name its colours, left to right, in one line."
